products.description: What your agents know about your system: a code graph over 114 languages, memory and knowledge, in a local CLI and MCP server (33 MCP tools across 3 domains). Stores injected edges that grep never sees, and your data sources' structure (never their rows) with the data shapes you approve. Absorbed wicked-brain (retired 2026-08): indexes codebase knowledge + memories, surfaced through wicked-garden's mem/search skill domains.

install.mcpInstructions: Index a repo first: wicked-estate index <path> --db ~/.wicked-estate/graph.db. The MCP server is wicked-estate-mcp. Both binaries install to ~/.local/bin from the sha256-verified GitHub release (~/.cargo/bin only when no prebuilt binary exists for the platform and cargo builds them). wicked-crew needs them to add a repository.

products.description: Local-first SQLite event bus. At-least-once delivery, push-over-durable-poll, no network transport. Decouples agents and tools without external infrastructure.

RETIRED (2026-08, v0.11.0 final). QE capabilities (40 specialist skills + acceptance trio) have moved to wicked-garden's qe domain. The acceptance gate is now wicked-crew. Data layer is wicked-ledger + wicked-vault. Install wicked-garden and wicked-crew instead.
products.note: Retired. npm package deprecated at 0.11.0. Do not install — use wicked-garden (qe domain) + wicked-crew instead.

products.description: RETIRED (2026-08, Phase 5-S7). Memory, knowledge, and search capabilities consolidated into wicked-estate. The npm package is deprecated. Use wicked-estate (memory + knowledge domains) via wicked-garden's mem/search skills instead.
products.note: Retired. npm package deprecated. Use wicked-estate instead — it ships all memory/knowledge/search capabilities. ~/.wicked-brain on disk is a frozen archive; never delete it.

products.description: Local-first evidence primitive — records claim-backing evidence with its acceptance criteria, re-derives integrity deterministically, and records independent third-party judgments. Internal infrastructure peer, not a marketed product: it is the honest-evidence backend wicked-garden's gate requires.
products.note: Dependency, not a standalone product — installed automatically when wicked-garden is selected (garden's evidence gate blocks without it).

products.description: Curated toolkit for what coding agents can't do alone: re-derives 'done' from evidence, sees injected edges, renames across files as a graph operation, multi-model review, 40-specialist QE domain, mem/search via wicked-estate. Opinionated bundle — all or nothing.

install.mcpInstructions: Run /wicked-garden-core setup in Claude Code to complete configuration (verifies peers; blocks only on wicked-vault, the one the evidence gate needs).

products.note: Opinionated bundle — you get everything. Individual components cannot be disabled.

capabilities.label: script-backed skills (the Codex plugin, or skills copied into Codex / OpenCode / Pi / Antigravity)

products.description: Foundation-plane document & render engine: document storage, version lineage, and HTML/PDF/PPTX rendering. wicked-crew spawns and proxies it (no standalone UI); surfaced through studio.

The ADE (agentic development environment) for running a team of coding agents: start a job with a chat, watch it, and answer the decisions that need you with the evidence. Build apps and dashboards over your databases in a chat, ask a question of your data, and see your sources, repos and approved data shapes on Understand's Knowledge map. Pure HTTP/WS client of crew's API. Ships bundled inside wicked-crew (npx wicked-crew serve opens the UI); also available as a standalone repo for custom deployments.

install.instructions: Wicked Studio ships bundled inside Wicked Crew — install wicked-crew and run `wicked-crew serve` to get Wicked Studio. For custom deployments, the standalone repo is mikeparcewski/wicked-studio.

products.description: The harness for the coding agents you already use: it runs them in sandboxes through gated jobs. By default a different agent reviews the work; when none can, the job stops unless you launch it as reduced assurance, which is labelled. Gates report the checks that actually ran. Runs Apps (live apps and dashboards over your databases; a change asked for in a chat is built, checked and reviewed by a different agent), and agents read your databases only through one read-only gate. Ships with Wicked Studio. Needs Wicked Garden (the skills every job follows), Wicked Estate (adding a repository indexes it) and uv (the skills environment); the installer brings all three.

capabilities.label: daemon for governed jobs + bundled Studio (wicked-crew serve)

products.description: The execution engine behind wicked-crew and the per-tool-call governance hook binary (`wicked-core gate-hook`). Rust; ships to npm as the `wicked-core-ts` addon plus five `wicked-core-ts-<platform>` packages, each carrying the stripped `wicked-core` binary stamped `wickedCoreVersion` (core-ts >= 0.7.26). Not on crates.io.

install.instructions: Nothing to install: wicked-core ships inside the wicked-core-ts platform package that wicked-crew pins — `npm i -g wicked-crew` brings the engine and the hook binary for this host. `wicked-crew --version` prints the wicked-core-ts BINDING version the daemon runs (three lines: wicked-crew, wicked-core-ts, wicked-studio); the hook binary's own engine semver is the `wickedCoreVersion` stamp in that platform package, and `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` → `components.engineBinaries` names the hook binary the daemon found.

bundles.description: Crew + Bus (Crew brings Garden, Vault and Estate) — the fastest way to run a governed multi-agent session in Wicked Studio. Also makes sure uv is installed (Crew builds its skills environment with it). After install, run `wicked-crew serve` and open http://127.0.0.1:7701.
The recommended starting point for Claude Code users. Bus + Garden gives you evidence-gated work, graph-aware refactoring, multi-model review, and the full QE skill domain.
Estate + Bus — the persistent memory, knowledge, and code-graph layer. Everything else queries it. Surfaced through wicked-garden's mem/search skill domains.
Wicked Interactive + Crew — the document/render engine driven through Crew, with live visibility into AI workflow sessions via Wicked Studio, which ships inside Crew.
Everything active — bus, estate, garden, interactive, and crew (which includes Wicked Studio). The complete wicked-* experience.
